entityFieldPolicy: All14 frozen Driver records,28 RELATED_SEARCH aliases and empty crosswalk reviewed; preserve definitions, mechanisms, scale, polarity/direction, modifiability, volatility, lag/time/persistence, indicators, methods, observability, caveats, evidence and narrative fields. No blocked canonical local fields found or repaired. Measurement/proxy, state/trait and current-versus-recall-window issues recorded.
rdsReview: No local RDS. All17 incident endpoints are Drivers, including external BIO-009, CUL-076, SOC-027 and SOC-082. PSY-078 remains a protected F09 RDS, not an effect target. No formula contribution or aggregate propagation introduced.
causalGateReview: STANDARD_CAUSAL for all existing F05 incident edges. Existing PRC membership does not establish a pathway; received support, stress appraisal and physiological recovery remain independent constructs requiring identified aligned segments.

layersConsidered.BIO: Breathwork/sleep-loss and physiology versus subjective experience reviewed; no new BIO Family science or old-pilot revision.
layersConsidered.PSY: Induction, regulation, appraisals, traits and emotional responses reviewed; latent capacity and strategy, state and disposition kept separate.
layersConsidered.SOC: Support, audience and exclusion evidence reused; actual received care versus felt support and network exposure distinguished.
layersConsidered.CUL: Shame-regulation norms, cross-cultural risk findings and self-conscious-emotion review; country membership/tightness not an exact norm manipulation.
layersConsidered.ENV: Greening cluster trial and contextual stressors considered; long-window symptoms, multicomponent operation and momentary states not conflated.
layersConsidered.INS: Cash-transfer trial and institutional/context constraints examined; one policy operation not generic resource/security Driver or universal efficacy.
layersConsidered.INF: Film/message/reappraisal/feedback exposures reviewed; content and composite ratings not separate discrete-effect claims.
layersConsidered.TEC: Remote delivery, audiovisual stimuli and platform tasks reviewed; method/platform occurrence alone not consequence evidence.

domainsConsidered.DELIBERATE_INTERVENTION: Breathing, film, reappraisal, compassion/hope strategies and cash/greening programs screened; two operation identities retained without efficacy.
domainsConsidered.ROUTINE_UNINTENDED_HUMAN_ACTIVITY: Daily support, attention, goal obstruction and emotional responses considered; laboratory analogs do not establish uncontrolled-event consequences.
domainsConsidered.EXTERNAL_EVENT_SHOCK: Pandemic/disruption and appraisal contexts considered; no universal exposure→emotion effect inferred from occurrence.
domainsConsidered.ENVIRONMENTAL_EXPOSURE: Greening/nature, audiovisual surroundings and threats considered; study scope and exact content preserved.
domainsConsidered.INSTITUTIONAL_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: Transfer/land-remediation rules and social-evaluation norms examined; policy occurrence not psychological effect proof.
domainsConsidered.TECHNOLOGICAL_CHANGE: Remote delivery, film presentation and task manipulation; platform operation does not create PSYWERX Relationships or directly target state substrate.
domainsConsidered.SOCIAL_NETWORK_EVENT_PROCESS: Received support/exclusion/audience interactions considered; perception, network ties and source-role constructs separated.
domainsConsidered.INFORMATIONAL_EXPOSURE: Fear/anger framing, film content, reappraisal and feedback considered; no aggregate-to-component inference.
domainsConsidered.BIOLOGICAL_PHYSIOLOGICAL_PROCESS: Sleep and breath changes reviewed; no trait alteration or physiological-to-subjective measure equivalence.

relationshipPropertyReview: All17 exact causal IDs reviewed locally or reused before PassB. Appraisal/control moderation of REL-PSY-026/027 and capacity moderation of REL-PSY-046 remain hypotheses: exact moderator construct, independent interaction estimate and timing not sufficiently aligned. No formal relationship-target effect, no B/C double contribution and no pathway from PRC labels.
propertyPolicy: All11 properties explicitly considered per Driver/edge. Neither retained effect has an established signed exact causal contrast, so LEVEL remains INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and direction UNKNOWN. Temporal/persistence claims are bounded questions; all unextracted dimensions retain NOT_INVESTIGATED. STRUCTURE cannot be used as a new generic context, ontology or RDS target.
identityReview: Compared all14 production HappeningTypes and9 Interventions plus six prior Layer candidates. No breathing or generic specified-film operation duplicate found. Overnight sleep-loss HT-V1-INF-F03-007 recognized but not reminted; heterogeneous sleep paradigms not treated as identical. Existing Cyberball exposure and F04 task-choice identities are not duplicated. Copyright/consent/control/medical/ethical/legal applicability independently required.

skepticalReview.method: Second pass after candidate drafting challenged exact comparator, measure identity, source bibliography, state/trait transfer and review independence. Reread primary methods and null results; downgraded both candidate effects to RESEARCH_NEEDED/UNKNOWN. Random check across threat/anxiety, guilt/pride, mood/arousal, stress and concern records.
checks: Verified canonical source IDs before trusting citations: four wrong PMIDs and unresolved IUS DOI retained as source-alignment issues, not canonical edits.
Breathwork pre/post anxiety reduction is not an active-comparator advantage; separate trait null and composite breathwork conditions retained.
Film DES profile contrasts do not establish same-item sadness-versus-neutral effect. Emotional intensity is not exact subjective activation; PANAS valence critique retained.
Wang reappraisal negative/positive averages cannot imply effects for every item. Attrition/demand and condition heterogeneity retained.

Cash stress/cortisol divergence, greening total-distress nondetection, dispositional fear/anger nulls, compassion active-control differences, and invalid frustration force/no EMG findings explicitly retained.
No causal graph weight, numerical mediation, direct RDS/state target, source registration or practitioner authority. Existing edge proposals unimplemented.
skepticalReview.remainingRisks: Exact-effect yield intentionally low. Source access often abstract-level; no claim of exhaustive null search. Further named clip/neutral contrast, intervention comparator and state time-window work belongs to research-needed queue, not automatic governance.
